summary: rs-short is a lightweight link shortener written in Rust. It provides basic URL redirection alongside built-in caching, spambot protection, and phishing detection.
goodFor: This is suitable if you prefer a compact, Rust-based utility for managing shortened URLs on your own infrastructure.
watchOut: The project currently has no tagged releases and no recorded repository stars or recent commits, indicating an early stage of development or lack of community activity.
deployNotes: As a Rust application, it typically compiles into a single binary that requires a reverse proxy for TLS termination and persistent storage configured externally if data retention across reboots is needed.
